derivation.method: clean-room implementation of the published keyboard chart
derivation.source: SPIonic font documentation (Jimmy Adair, Scholars Press, 1998) — the font and its encoding chart are in the public domain; cross-checked against the MIT-licensed IAS-Scholars/SPIonic-to-Unicode TECkit mapping
derivation.note: SPIonic follows the TLG Beta Code convention: diacritic keys FOLLOW their vowel; case is carried by letter case (not by Beta Code asterisks). Uppercase V and J and lowercase v are deliberately unmapped (archaic-letter slots the chart does not settle); they surface as flagged unmapped codes.

validation.method: decoded 24 real-world SPIonic passages from the public web (tertullian.org, typeset 1998-2008); TLG-E attestation of all output tokens (len>=3)
validation.residual: the single unattested token (ὑπεργέιων) faithfully reproduces a typist error in the source page (accent keyed after epsilon instead of after the diphthong)

punctuation_notes.?: sub-linear dot (editorial uncertainty siglum) — deliberately unmapped, surfaces flagged
punctuation_notes.8: overstrike line (nomina sacra) — deliberately unmapped, surfaces flagged
